newsitem.title: USA: Virginia Power Surry nukes resume full power.
newsitem.headline: Virginia Power Surry nukes resume full power.

text.p: Virginia Power Co's Surry nuclear power units 1 and 2, each with a capacity of 781 megawatts (MW), returned to full power Monday after shutdowns, the Nuclear Regulatory Commission (NRC) said.
Both of the units were operating at full power as of early Monday following separate maintenance shutdowns, the NRC said in its daily plant status report.
Surry unit 1 was shut Wednesday for repairs after a pressure drop in the reactor coolant system was detected, and resumed electricity production over the weekend.
Surry unit 2 was shut Tuesday after losing power in its electrical hydraulic control system, and resynchronized to the power grid on Friday.
The Surry units are located at Gravel Neck, Va.
Virginia Power is a subsidiary of Dominion Resources.
